description_en: Queries the list and details of video stream push jobs, including the creation time, current push status, job type, and push URL
description_zh: 调用接口QueryStreamPushJobList查询视频推流任务列表及详情：创建时间、当前推流状态、任务类型、推流地址等
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-stream-push-job-list --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id d7XmBoJhAr88C6PelXDF000000 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --current-page 1 --job-type 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryStreamPushJobList

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page of the returned results. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100，默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information of all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page of the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results to display. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页的内容。默认值是起始页码1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The type of the stream push job.

- **1** (default): continuous job.
- **2**: trigger-based job that ends after interruption
parameters.help_zh:
推流任务类型。

- **1**（默认）：持续型任务。
- **2**：触发式任务，中断后结束
parameters.name: job_type
